notes.title: Please give us your suggestion
notes.content:
The game has been out for three weeks and it's been a great experience for me.
I hope you can give me some suggestions. let's start with a few interesting questions.

1. Is there a big discrepancy between the trailer and your experience?
2. What do you hate most about this game?
3. The game will add more rooms, what kind of room do you want?
4. The game currently has no ratings or other goals. Do you think it would be better to have goals?

If you have more suggestions please feel free to comment.
Thank you.
